name: HRC_ALERT_RUN_LOG_LINES
description: Contains alert run Logs for a given run.

columns.name: RUN_LOG_LINE_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key column.

columns.name: RUN_ID
columns.description: Run Identifier. Foreign Key to HRC_ALERT_RUNS.RUN_ID

columns.name: PHASE
columns.description: Specifies the Alert Run Phase. Valid values are: ORA_PHASE1,ORA_PHASE2,ORA_PHASE3

columns.name: LOG_SOURCE
columns.description: Specifies the source of the Alert Log. Valid values are: Run,Message,Recipient,RecipientExpression,GroupByExpression,Template

columns.name: LOG_WEIGHT
columns.description: Specifies the weight of the Alert Log record.

columns.name: RUN_LANGUAGE
columns.description: Run Lanugage in which the Alert template is identified and Alert run is executed.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_NAME
columns.description: Templates user defined name.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SURROGATE_ID
columns.description: SurrogateId of the record of the rest resource related table that is configured in the Alert.

columns.name: PROP_NAME
columns.description: Property Name of the Alert Run Log record.

columns.name: PROP_VALUE
columns.description: Property Value of the Alert Run Log record.

columns.name: FUNC_NAME
columns.description: Function Name of the Alert Run Log record.

columns.name: FUNC_ARG_NAME1
columns.description: Function First Argument Name of the record.

columns.name: FUNC_ARG_VAL1
columns.description: Function First Argument Value of the record.

columns.name: FUNC_ARG_NAME2
columns.description: Function Second Argument Name of the record.

columns.name: FUNC_ARG_VAL2
columns.description: Function Second Argument Value of the record.

columns.name: FUNC_ARG_NAME3
columns.description: Function Third Argument Name of the record.

columns.name: FUNC_ARG_VAL3
columns.description: Function Third Argument Value of the record.

columns.name: LOG_TYPE
columns.description: Log type of the Alert Run Log record.

columns.name: LOG_SUBTYPE
columns.description: Log Subtype of the Alert Run Log record.
